title: The confined master session reaches the main Herdr after a migration
description: Migrates a fixture install from its private Herdr to the host's main one, then launches the master session the way the loop does: under its real confinement it runs herdr agent list and master review GY-N against the main server's own socket, and the loop closes the master pane a migration left in the moved-away workspace and relaunches the master.

steps.name: Confined master session on the main Herdr
